text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for everything, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I know I said I wanted to run on the racetrack to prepare for the big day, but... booking it must have been tough, right?
choice_data_list: No, don't worry about it. It's something I want to do.
No, don't worry about it. It's something I want to do.

text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to Tokyo Racecourse alongside the legends.
As for why—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
By royal command.
Assist in the return of St Lite and the others.

A few months ago, right after the legends decided to enter the 'Dream Fest',
I received that exact directive from her.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Lukewarm. What is this
spineless training menu?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cease your consideration for them.
—Make the correction at once.
choice_data_list: ...Got it! I'll think about it a bit more!
...Got it! I'll think about it a little more!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I hear their records have been stagnating as of late. Explain yourselves."
choice_data_list: Everyone's too intimidated to run alongside me...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hm.
If so, I shall be your opponent. Prepare yourself.
It seems her "royal decree" was more serious this time than ever before. Working alongside her to help the legends make their return resulted in—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre. Trainer.
Thank you very much for your repeated assistance."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I won't say I've "reclaimed" it—
but I have become someone worthy of standing alongside my beloved children.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Now I just have to do it!
When the day comes, I will show you a run
worthy of past glory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Now then, for the finishing touches—
Let the King bear witness to your running.

We pass through the underground tunnel heading toward the track.
Suddenly, a question on my mind slips out.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Is it not obvious? It is so that after I restore their former glory—I may crush them.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is to display my majestic might at the "Dream Fest."

From my perspective, she had already displayed enough majesty.
I couldn't see any reason for her to shine any brighter, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Just picture it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“—As long as I am here, the turf will never perish.
Then what if I were to depart the Twinkle Series?”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The nation fell pathetically.
All because it lost its king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――No.
I will not permit it. Not an end such as this. This king will never...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"……Thus, I shall leave it behind in that race.
A blazing fire that will make the young grass long for the turf."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Behold the King's "Radiance."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And if so, will it not be kindled?
With that brilliance as a beacon—the flame of the next era.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do you understand? Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: From here on, I shall rule the future.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Behold.
The moment the King engraves her prosperity.
I could only stand there in silence. So that was it... She was finally about to seize the very future of racing in her grasp—

Thinking that far, a vision appears before my eyes.
A glimpse into the future... after the King leaves the turf.

There was a queen challenging the ultimate queen.
There was a champion kicking up dirt in a foreign land.
And many other Umamusume captivated by kings—

They run on turf. They run on dirt.
Endlessly. Forever—a single, unwavering path.
Aiming solely for the radiant beacon left behind by the great king—
